ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_001.en: I will inform our superiors about the capture of the Troll leader. Keep a close watch on the prisoners, commander, as there is no telling what vile schemes they are already hatching.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_001.tr: 我会向上级通报巨魔首领被俘一事。盯紧这些囚犯，指挥官，你永远也摸不透它们在策划些什么阴谋。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_002.en: Don’t worry, my men know a thing or two about handling outlaws.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_002.tr: 别担心，我的人知道怎么对付这群渣滓。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_003.en: Do not underestimate the Forest Trolls, for they are unlike anything your men have ever faced. I will leave you a dozen of my archers.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_003.tr: 别低估森林巨魔，它们和你见过的任何敌人都不一样。我会给你留下一队弓箭手。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_001.en: Our scouts have confirmed that a band of human soldiers have captured a war party led by troll commander Zul’jin, and have taken them to a secret prison near the outskirts of Durnholde Keep.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_001.tr: 我们的斥候已经确认，一队人类士兵俘获了祖尔金和他的手下，并准备将他们押往敦霍尔德城堡附近的秘密监狱。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_002.en: Seeing an opportunity to place these captives in debt to the Horde, Doomhammer has commanded that we focus our efforts on liberating Zul’jin and his trolls. Once freed from the clutches of their human captors, we are to return them to the safety of their own encampment nearby.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_002.tr: 毁灭之锤命令我们集中精力解救祖尔金和他的巨魔，好让他们欠部落一个人情。一旦将他们从人类手中救出，我们就立刻护送他们到附近的巨魔营地。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_003.en: This raid upon the unsuspecting prison will strike terror into the hearts of those who would dare resist the Horde!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_003.tr: 突袭这座毫无防备的城堡，让敢于反抗部落的人类品尝恐惧！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_001.en: Hmm...Forest Trolls, how convenient. Let us approach with caution.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_001.tr: 嗯……森林巨魔，真是得来全不费工夫。大家小心行事。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_002.en: Greetings, Amani, we have been dispatched by our Warchief to rescue your legendary leader. Were you part of Zul'jin's war-party?
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_002.tr: 你好啊，阿曼尼。大酋长派我们来营救你们尊贵的首领。你是祖尔金的手下吗？

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_003.en: Amani... we've not been called by dat name for generations, not since the days of our great empire of old. You be well versed in our history, stranger.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_003.tr: 阿曼尼……数代以来，已经没人这么称呼咱了，这个头衔自我们的古老帝国陷落后就湮没在了历史的长河中。看来你对咱的历史很了解，陌生人。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_004.en: We were indeed led by the great Zul'jin, until we be ambushed by da Humans. Three of us were killed, and da rest were captured. I managed to evade capture so I could warn my brethren of Zul'jin's abduction.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_004.tr: 我们几个确实是祖尔金大人的手下，不过那是被人类偷袭前的事了。它们杀害了我们三位兄弟，还抓走了其他人。我侥幸逃过一劫，正要回去告诉族人祖尔金被俘一事。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_005.en: Their camp be on da other side of da forest, but da path be blocked by dat accursed human settlement.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_005.tr: 他们的营地就在森林的另一边，可惜路被人类定居点挡住了。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_006.en: We cannot make it there on our own, but if ya truly be here to help us, den we will show you how to build a proper Troll Lumber Mill and grant you the use of our tools and weapons!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_006.tr: 哥几个没法独自做到这些，要是你们能帮咱一把，咱就能教你们如何建造巨魔伐木场。再把咱的工具和武器借你们使使！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_007.en: Zul'jin is of great interest to our Warchief. That is why we are here to slaughter his captors and deliver him to safety. We will aid you in your plight, Amani.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_007.tr: 我们的大酋长对祖尔金很感兴趣，这才让我们宰了这群歹徒，把你们护送到安全之地。我们会帮你们摆脱困境的，阿曼尼。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_008.en: Our axes are yours to command, Orc Master.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_008.tr: 我们的战斧听您指挥，兽人主子。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S004_001.en: Hmm... a patrol. Their camp must be nearby.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S004_001.tr: 嗯……一支侦察队。它们的营地就在附近。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_001.en: Chieftain, I know our focus must be Zul’jin, but burning this place to the ground would greatly weaken Durnholde.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_001.tr: 酋长，营救祖尔金虽然是头等大事，但把此地化为焦土能大大削弱敦霍尔德方面的力量。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_002.en: You are right, Utok, and the carnage would do well in covering our escape. See it done!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_002.tr: 你说得对，乌托克。一场大屠杀能极大掩盖我们的行踪。好好看着吧！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_001.en: Thank you strangers, I owe you my life.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_001.tr: 谢谢你，陌生人，我欠你一条命。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_002.en: Greetings Zul’jin, I am Rend Blackhand of the Orcish Horde. We have come to deliver you to safety.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_002.tr: 向你致敬，祖尔金！我是兽人部落的雷德·黑手。我们是来护送你前往安全地带的。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_003.en: Then we be truly in your debt, Rend Blackhand. Da shortest path to our village leads through da swamp.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_003.tr: 那我们就真欠你一个人情了，雷德·黑手。穿越沼泽是回村最快的路。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_004.en: Then we’d best get going. We will continue this conversation once you and your people are safe.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_004.tr: 最好赶紧动身。等我们安全了，再谈也不迟。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_001.en: Murlocs! I hate these two legged frog freaks… what are they doing here?
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_001.tr: 鱼人！我讨厌这些两条腿的类蛙怪物……它们在这儿干什么？

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_002.en: It seems like the pests are a widespread plague on this world, Chieftain, much like Podlings back on Draenor.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_002.tr: 看来这些害虫就像瘟疫般遍布这个世界，酋长。和德拉诺的魔荚人一样。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_003.en: I see… all the more reason to exterminate them!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_003.tr: 我懂了……那更得杀光它们了！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_001.en: Aargh, again with these slimy walking frogs! Must we mire ourselves with their blood everywhere?!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_001.tr: 啊啊啊！又是这些黏糊糊的两腿怪蛙，每次都要让它们的血溅的到处都是吗？！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_002.en: They be a nuisance for everyone, friend. All races consider dem pests, even da elves and da humans, a rare matter dat we agree on.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_002.tr: 朋友，没人不讨厌它们。所有种族都把鱼人视为害虫，就连人类和精灵也不例外，这恐怕是我们之间鲜有的共识了。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_003.tr: 那就……杀了它们，杀光它们！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S010_001.en: The orcs are freeing the trolls! Stop them!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S010_001.tr: 兽人要把巨魔放跑了！阻止它们！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_001.en: It be Zul'jin! thank da loa! he's alive!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_001.tr: 是祖尔金！感谢神灵！他还活着！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_002.en: Who be those green skins that accompany him?
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_002.tr: 那些陪他回来的绿皮肤是谁？

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_001.en: Now dat we are safe, we can continue our conversation. On behalf of the Forest Trolls, I thank you for your help.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_001.tr: 现在我们安全了，继续刚才的话题吧。我代表森林巨魔，感谢你们的援助。

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_002.en: Da Elves of Quel’thalas are our eternal enemies. In ancient times dey ravaged our empire with the help of da humans, and now history be repeating itself! Those mongrels were going to take me to Quel’thalas and put me in a cage for all the world to see!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_002.tr: 奎尔萨拉斯的高等精灵是我们的万古血仇！在遥远的过去，它们伙同人类摧毁了我们神圣的帝国，如今还妄图重蹈覆辙！这些杂种想把我带回奎尔萨拉斯、关在笼子里，在世人面前羞辱伟大的阿曼尼！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_003.en: You are a mighty warrior, Zul’jin! We will protect your people and bring ruin to all your enemies. In return you will provide us with your finest scouts and warriors.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_003.tr: 你是一名强大的战士，祖尔金！我们将保护你的子民，摧毁你的敌人！作为回报，请让你最好的斥候和战士协助我们吧！

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_005.en: It be good to be here, Rend Blackhand.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_005.tr: 很高兴能加入你们，雷德·黑手。
